newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-,12-mo up, 9-mo down.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine T-bill yields: 3-,6-,12-mo up, 9-mo down.

text.p: Average yields at auctions of three-, six-, and 12-month treasury bills edged up and yields of nine-month treasury bills slipped from the last sales, a central bank statement said on Tuesday.

Three-month bills rose to 25.01 percent from 24.33 percent, six-month bills firmed to 31.30 percent from 30.52 percent, nine-month bills edged down to 34.86 percent from 34.88 percent, and 12-month bills firmed to 39.72 percent from 39.64 percent.
The results of Monday's three-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 23.99 million UAH 3.24 million UAH
Actual amount raised 22.58 million UAH 3.05 million UAH
The central bank sold 239,868 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 237,776 were competitive and 2,092 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of three-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 8.
The results of six-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 5.84 million UAH 11.08 million UAH
Actual amount raised 5.05 million UAH 9.61 million UAH
The central bank sold 58,447 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 54,955 were competitive and 3,492 were non-competitive.
The date of the next auction of six-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 8.
The results of nine-month discount T-bills auction, compared to last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 26.95 million UAH 21.44 million UAH
Actual amount raised 21.38 million UAH 17.00 million UAH
The central bank sold 269,538 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those 269,518 were competitive and 20 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of nine-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 8.
The results of the 12-month discount T-bill auction, compared to the last issue, were as follows:
Issue volume no limit stated no limit stated
Amount sold 53.61 million UAH 29.41 million UAH
Actual amount raised 38.40 million UAH 21.08 million UAH
The central bank sold 536,145 T-bills, the bank's statement said. Of those, 532,612 were competitive and 3,533 were non-competitive bids.
The date of the next auction of 12-month discount T-bills is scheduled for April 8.
